title: Primary Associated Types: some Collection<Int>
hints: `Collection<Int>` constrains the element type without naming a concrete collection.
`[any Sequence<Int>]` can hold an array, a reversed view and your lazy sequence together.
jsBridge: `some Collection<Int>` constrains an opaque type's element, like TS `Iterable<number>`. Primary associated types (Swift 5.7) make protocol generics feel like TS generic interfaces.
